core_obligations: Bounded below case (proof lines 9526-9530): represent the object by a bounded below complex of injectives and apply the acyclicity lemma together with the vanishing of the higher cohomology of the pullback of an injective module.
Reduce (1) to (2) (proof lines 9531-9533): in the unbounded case, note that statement (1) is a special case of statement (2).

Unbounded case for (2) (proof lines 9534-9540): the displayed chain of equalities rewrites R Gamma(U, g^*M) as R Hom over the source of j_{U!}O_U into g^*M, then as R Hom over the target of j_{u(U)!}O_{u(U)} into M by the adjunction of the derived lower shriek, and finally as R Gamma(u(U), M).
proof_roadmap: Handle bounded below objects by injective resolutions and the acyclicity of the pullback of injectives.
For the unbounded case use adjunction of the derived lower shriek to move the Hom to the target site.
difficulty_reason: The lemma compares cohomology on an object of the source site with cohomology on its image, for the pullback of a complex and for the pullback in the ringed setting (statement lines 9510-9523). The proof (proof lines 9525-9540) treats the bounded below case by injective resolutions and acyclicity, and the unbounded case by the adjunction between the derived lower shriek and the pullback. H2: two short arguments, written out.
